name: agent-electron
title: Agent Electron
description: Drive cicy-desktop Electron BrowserWindows and per-account sandbox sessions via desktop_event RPC. Each accountIdx = its own session.fromPartition() with proxy. Electron analog of agent-chrome.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Electron
zh-CN.description: 驱动 cicy-desktop 的 Electron BrowserWindow 和 per-account session。accountIdx = sandbox-N partition，可设置 proxy；session 下所有 window 共享代理。对标 agent-chrome 的电子端版本。

tools.name: sessions
tools.description: List sandbox sessions, grouped by accountIdx (each = persist:sandbox-N)

tools.name: session
tools.description: Show the windows + partition + proxy of one session (accountIdx)

tools.name: proxy
tools.description: Set the upstream proxy on a session — applies to every window opened under that accountIdx

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open <url> in a BrowserWindow (--idx selects the session, default 1). Check windows first: if the URL is already open, win.show()/focus() it and report its winId; --no-reuse forces a fresh window

tools.name: windows
tools.description: List all live Electron BrowserWindows on the host

tools.name: window
tools.description: Show one BrowserWindow's details (url, title, load state, session)

tools.name: url
tools.description: Load a new URL in an existing BrowserWindow

tools.name: cdp
tools.description: Send a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol command to a BrowserWindow's webContents

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot a window (to clipboard by default, or to a file with --out)

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture a DOM/accessibility snapshot of a window's page

tools.name: sysinfo
tools.description: Host system info (platform, electron/chrome versions, screens)
